instructions: Closed book. For each item: read the stem only and write your solution in stem_only before you read the options. Then choose the answer labels. Use no sources. Set flag to one sentence when you see a second defensible answer or a missing constraint, else null.

items.stem: A company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled. The root of the organization has the FullAWSAccess SCP. In the Workloads organizational unit (OU), the company replaced FullAWSAccess with an allow-list SCP that allows only Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, and Amazon CloudWatch actions. One account in the Workloads OU now needs Amazon Athena and AWS Glue. The account has FullAWSAccess attached directly, and the IAM role of its analytics team allows Athena and AWS Glue actions. Every other account in the Workloads OU must keep the current allow list. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Keep the account in the Workloads OU, and attach an SCP that allows Athena and AWS Glue actions directly to the account, next to FullAWSAccess.

options.label: B
options.text: Create a new OU under the root with an SCP that allows Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, CloudWatch, Athena, and AWS Glue, and move the account there.

options.label: C
options.text: Create a new account in a new OU whose SCPs allow Athena, and migrate the workloads and data of the account to the new account.

options.label: D
options.text: Keep the account in the Workloads OU, and add Athena and AWS Glue actions to the allow-list SCP that is attached to the Workloads OU.

items.stem: A company uses AWS Control Tower. The accounts in the Workloads organizational unit (OU) hold Amazon S3 buckets that store audit logs. Developers in these accounts deploy changes with the AWS Management Console and the AWS CLI. The company must prevent all IAM users and roles in the Workloads OU accounts from deleting the audit log buckets. An alert after a deletion is not enough. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an SCP that denies the deletion of the audit log buckets, and attach the SCP in AWS Organizations to the Workloads OU that holds these accounts.

options.label: B
options.text: Turn on a detective control for the Workloads OU in AWS Control Tower, so that an AWS Config rule reports the deletion of the audit log buckets.

options.label: C
options.text: Create an SCP that denies the deletion of the audit log buckets, and attach the SCP in AWS Organizations to each account of the Workloads OU.

options.label: D
options.text: Turn on a proactive control for the Workloads OU in AWS Control Tower, so that a CloudFormation hook checks the deletion of the audit log buckets.
